description: Fetch Transfermarkt player profiles, market-value timelines, transfer records, clubs and competitions by name, ID or URL.

clubIds.description: Transfermarkt club IDs or URLs, one per line. Used by club and club-transfer modes.
clubIds.title: Club IDs or URLs

competitionIds.description: Transfermarkt competition codes (e.g. GB1, ES1) or URLs, one per line.
competitionIds.title: Competition codes or URLs

includeAbsences.description: Add injuries, suspensions and national-team call-ups for each player.
includeAbsences.title: Include absences

includeAchievements.description: Add trophies and awards for each player. Adds one request per player.
includeAchievements.title: Include achievements

includeCompetitionClubs.description: Add the club list and table positions to competition records.
includeCompetitionClubs.title: Include competition clubs

includeMarketValueHistory.description: Add every valuation Transfermarkt has recorded for each player.
includeMarketValueHistory.title: Include market-value history

includeSquad.description: Add the current or selected-season squad to club records. byClubId also emits one player record per squad member.
includeSquad.title: Include club squads

includeTransferHistory.description: Add each player's career transfers, including fees and clubs.
includeTransferHistory.title: Include transfer history

maxItems.description: Stop after this many top-level records.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

minMarketValueEur.description: Only keep players whose current market value is at least this many euros.
minMarketValueEur.title: Minimum market value (EUR)

mode.description: Choose a player, club, competition, transfer or auto-detect mode.
enumTitles: Player profiles by ID or URL
Club profile and squad by ID or URL
Clubs in a competition by ID or URL
mode.title: What to scrape

nationality.description: Only keep players whose nationality contains this text, e.g. Argentina or Brazil.
nationality.title: Nationality filter

playerIds.description: Transfermarkt player IDs or profile URLs, one per line. Used by player and player-transfer modes.
playerIds.title: Player IDs or URLs

position.description: Only keep players in this position.
position.title: Position filter

query.description: Player, club or competition name. Used by the three search modes. At least 2 characters.
query.title: Search query

season.description: Club and competition modes only. Use 2025 for 2025/26. Leave empty for the current season.
season.title: Season start year

urls.description: Player, club or competition URLs for auto-detect mode. Mixing page types is allowed.
urls.title: Transfermarkt URLs

title: Transfermarkt Scraper Input
